It also records already_allocated 10.11 and target_value 8.41, which inflate the focus-fire plan. The shot is weak and gains little. Fix: Drop a shooter from a focus-fire plan when its expected damage is under about 5% of the target's remaining wounds. Choose its target by expected damage and by cover or visibility instead of by the plan. Treat a shot beyond half range as a low-value shot, and consider moving or advancing the unit toward an objective instead.
